d.d: A bird hunted or kept for food, grouped into landfowl (order Galliformes), also called gamefowl, and waterfowl (order Anseriformes: ducks, geese, swans, etc.), which together form the clade Galloanserae.

d.x: We took our guns and went fowling.

d.d: To use or traverse in pursuit of fowls.
third-person singular simple present indicative of fowl
